open_points.subject: Overall progress numeric precision
open_points.text: Overall progress: `Σ(work_planned × percent) / Σ(work_planned)` ... undefined (shown unavailable) when the denominator is 0. The revised text no longer states whether this non-money percentage is rounded, at what precision, or whether rounding occurs only once after division.
open_points.question: What exact Decimal scale and rounding point must `overall_progress_percent` use when the quotient is non-terminating?
options: Round the final quotient once, half-up to 2 fraction digits
Return the quotient using the implementation's Decimal context precision
Apply another explicitly chosen percentage precision
open_points.default_guess: Round the final quotient once, half-up to 2 fraction digits.

witness.initial: The active budget has sections A and B with work_planned 1.00 and 2.00; their recorded completion percentages are 66 and 67.
events: An operator records both progress values.
outcomes: The viewer receives overall_progress_percent 66.67 after final half-up rounding to two places.
The viewer receives a longer Decimal-context value such as 66.66666666666666666666666667 because no percentage scale is specified.
witness.observer: The viewer or any API consumer comparing or displaying overall_progress_percent
